seoTitle: About the game | Pirate Hero - browser RPG
seoDescription: Pirate Hero: a free browser RPG. Character, missions, work, training, arena, dungeons, ship, quests, titles, and rankings - no install required.
heroLead: A free pirate-themed browser RPG - grow your captain, sail on missions, and earn fame!
introBodyRest: is a free browser RPG in the spirit of classic browser heroes, set in a pirate world. You create a captain, improve five attributes, collect gear, run timed missions and jobs, train stats, fight in the arena, clear multi-stage dungeons, join a ship, and chase quests and titles. No install - play in your browser.
characterBody: Create a unique pirate and level them up. Spend skill points - strength, agility, stamina, intelligence, and luck shape combat, missions, and training. Unlock titles and equip loot from your inventory.
characterBullets: Gear, storage, and a shop with item rarities
arenaBody: Challenge other players to duels. Battles resolve on the server from your stats, gear, and boosters. Earn fame, spend fight points, and climb the player ladder.
arenaBullets: Server-resolved fights driven by your build
Fame, fight points, and fight history
dungeonBody: Send your hero on timed missions (energy), work for gold, train attributes, and storm multi-stage dungeons with a bestiary. On your ship, grow the crew, upgrade the ship, and fight in ship battles.
dungeonBullets: Missions, jobs, and training with separate resources
Multi-stage dungeons (Crypt, Kraken, Fortress, Volcano, Palace)
Ship: crew, upgrades, treasury, chat, and ship battles
statsLead: Pirate Hero is built for daily loops - missions, work, arena, dungeons, or ship progress are always waiting.

mechanics.title: Gear & shop
mechanics.desc: Buy, sell, and equip weapons and armor. Items have rarities and rolled stats - from common to legendary.

mechanics.title: PvP arena
mechanics.desc: Challenge players, spend fight points, earn fame, and review your duel history.

mechanics.title: Ship
mechanics.desc: Join a crew, fund the treasury, upgrade the ship, chat, and fight in ship battles.

mechanics.title: Missions, work & training
mechanics.desc: Missions cost energy, jobs pay gold, training spends training points - with optional gold refills.

mechanics.title: Dungeons & quests
mechanics.desc: Clear dungeon stages, fill the bestiary, claim quest rewards, and collect the daily login bonus.

mechanics.title: Boosters & economy
mechanics.desc: Use boosters, coupons, and premium diamonds. Rankings compare both captains and ships.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.desc: Create a free account in seconds - email and password, then activate your account.

steps.title: Board the ship
steps.desc: Sign in and check your character, gear, and resources (gold, energy, training and fight points).

steps.title: Set sail
steps.desc: Start a mission or job, fight in the arena, enter a dungeon, or join a ship - and claim your daily bonus!

ctaLead: Create an account and start your pirate legend - free, straight from the browser.
